title: Initial about:blank window reuse changes active document too early
body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

In  [create and initialize a Document object](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-lifecycle.html#initialise-the-document-object),

Step 6. reuses the existing Window when replacing a same-origin initial about:blank document.

> 6. If browsingContext's [active document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#active-document)'s [is initial about:blank](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/dom.html#is-initial-about:blank) is true, and browsingContext's [active document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#active-document)'s [origin](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-document-origin) is [same origin-domain](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsers.html#same-origin-domain) with navigationParams's [origin](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#navigation-params-origin), then set window to browsingContext's [active window](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/document-sequences.html#active-window).

Step 10 then sets that Window's associated Document to the newly created Document

> 10. Set window's [associated Document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/nav-history-apis.html#concept-document-window) to document.

However, a browsing context’s active document is its active window’s associated Document. That makes the browsing context’s active document switch before the new document is actually activated.

Example problem as a result of this:
```html
  <!-- top.html -->
  <iframe id="target" src="helper.html"></iframe>
  <script>
  const FunctionFromIframe = target.contentWindow.Function;
  target.addEventListener("load", () => {
      const getTitle = FunctionFromIframe("return document.title;");
      console.log(getTitle()); // expected: "loaded iframe realm"
  }, { once: true });
  </script>

  <!-- helper.html -->
  <!DOCTYPE html><title>loaded iframe realm</title>
```

Function is captured from the iframe's initial `about:blank` Window. Per step 6, that same Window is reused when `helper.html` loads  so `FunctionFromIframe` should use the loaded document's realm when invoked. This only works correctly if the Window's associated Document doesn't switch until the document is actually activated.

For full reference, we originally ran into this issue all the way back in https://github.com/serenityos/serenity/issues/22293

And as a result have not taken this branch in our [implementation](https://github.com/LadybirdBrowser/ladybird/blob/dafd624177e1df05452f6a8beac79fef3f2b9f9e/Libraries/LibWeb/DOM/Document.cpp#L343), which was causing [promise-job-entry-different-function-realm.html](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/blob/master/html/webappapis/scripting/processing-model-2/integration-with-the-javascript-job-queue/promise-job-entry-different-function-realm.html) to crash, leading to me reinvestigating that problem.


A shorter term fix which I'm thinking of making to ladybird for this is to not perform:

> 10. Set window's [associated Document](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/nav-history-apis.html#concept-document-window) to document.

In the case that we've taken the window reuse branch, instead performing that switch in [make active](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/browsing-the-web.html#make-active). I don't find this change very clean though.

Another option might be to keep the switch where it is, but (somehow) define active document observability separately so it does not become visible too early.
